title: Search for Joy A #PoetryPort Poem #clmooc #writingcommunity
summary: A search for joy unfurls in our world as a hunt for purpose swirled in a thirst for good people treated with unequal gratitude as you bank thanks for others and smother yourself in doing you.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
A search for joy
unfurls in our world
as a hunt for purpose
swirled in
a thirst for good people
treated with
unequal gratitude
as you bank thanks
for others
and smother yourself
in doing you.
